premises.text: Male fertility is declining and often responsible for couple infertility, but clinic testing/freezing is awkward and clinical so men avoid it
premises.evidence_span: All men should be thinking about freezing and testing their sperm, but the problem is the experience today is so awkward and clinical of going to a clinic to do it

premises.text: Discrete at-home kit with deposit cup and buffering medium enables pickup to partner clinic for testing, analysis, freezing, personalized fertility report, and post-thaw motility check
premises.evidence_span: when a client makes an order online, this is what they receive at home, and it is discrete packaging

premises.text: GTM via employer fertility benefits, DTC to high-income professional men, and indirect outreach to partners; priced ~10% of egg freezing
premises.evidence_span: 250 companies in the United States offer fertility benefits to their employees, focused largely on IVF and egg freezing. We think every one of those companies should be a client of Legacies as well

domains.name: At-home test and freeze kit workflow

value.text: Consumer-friendly testing and freezing of men's fertility assets with privacy and quality
value.evidence_span: Legacy is the first company focused on the consumer experience of testing and then freezing men's most valuable assets

causal_links.evidence_span: the experience today is so awkward and clinical of going to a clinic to do it
pick up the kit from the client's home, send it to our partner clinic where it is tested, analyzed, and then frozen
our product is 10% of that cost and can be done at home with 100% customer satisfaction

notes: Risk-factor list and fertility-burden statistics folded into one male-fertility pain-bundle (rule 6). Kit components, five-step web process, report metrics, and post-thaw check folded into one at-home workflow mechanism.
